newsitem.title: FRANCE: Abbey Nat France to offer consumer loans.
newsitem.headline: Abbey Nat France to offer consumer loans.

text.p: British bank Abbey National said on Thursday its French subsidiary Abbey National France planned to start offering consumer loans from July 3.

Abbey National France, which currently specialises in mortgages, said in a statement it would be offering loans from 10,000 francs to 100,000 francs and consumers would not need to stipulate what they wanted to spend the money on.
It said the loans would be for a period of three to five years and interest rates, excluding insurance, would start at eight percent.
